prompts:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: wide 16:9 children's storybook animation BACKGROUND PLATE for MyStarQuest.
Input image 1 is the existing fossil-dig scene: preserve its sunny fossil site, art style, character identities and outfits. Input images 2 and 3 from src/assets/teenie are authoritative identity references for Eclipse and Diana, including their crowns, hairstyles, dresses and facial features.
Create the next shot: a MUCH WIDER pulled-back view of the SAME sunny fossil dig. Odette (brown-haired normal girl with blue eyes, lavender jumper, purple heart-patterned leggings) kneels at BOTTOM LEFT with her fossil brush. Diana (pastel lilac hair, large gold jeweled crown, pale blue dress, magnifying glass) kneels beside her at lower left-middle. Eclipse (lavender hair, tall dark crystal crown, original purple dress, small trowel) kneels at BOTTOM RIGHT. They smile and look up toward the sky. Small brushes, bucket, fossil tray, spiral ammonites in sandy dig. Rope fence, green trees, layered warm rock ledges and distant blue-green hills. All three must be much smaller than the close-up reference, in the lowest third of the frame, entire crowns below y=65%.
Composition is essential: horizon at y=62%. The upper 60% is a generous open clear blue sky with a few soft white clouds ONLY near the edges. Keep especially x=35%-90%, y=6%-58% unobstructed empty sky for a separately animated large flying dinosaur princess. Leave open sandy space at lower centre. Do NOT include any dinosaur, unicorn, bird, flying character, rainbow, text, caption, speech bubble, frame, logo or watermark. This is the CLEAN PLATE before the princess arrives. Preserve the same polished rounded 3D family-animation rendering, warm daylight, detailed sand, friendly vivid colours and soft depth of field. Landscape 16:9.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: image 1, the wide sunny fossil dig background plate. Preserve its 16:9 composition, blue sky, clouds, hills, rock terraces, sand, fossils, rope fence, rendering and daylight.
Make ONE targeted compositional correction: redraw all THREE diggers at about 60% of their current size, keeping them kneeling on the same ground baseline y=90%. Odette at x=15%, Diana at x=32%, Eclipse at x=83%. They should each be only 20-24% of the total image height, including the whole crown, with ALL crowns and hair entirely below y=65%. Their smaller scale is essential because an enormous dinosaur princess will be animated separately above them, large enough for Odette to easily ride on her broad back.
Keep their smiling upward-looking faces and exact outfits: Odette brown hair with lavender clip, blue eyes, lavender sweater, heart-patterned purple leggings and brush. Diana pale lilac hair, large gold jeweled crown, pale blue dress and magnifying glass. Eclipse lavender hair, very tall dark crystal crown, original purple starry outfit and trowel. Images 2 and 3 are authoritative Teenieping identity references; preserve identity, colours, features and accessories. Scale nearby bucket/hand tools consistently. Naturally fill the space left around their old positions with the existing landscape. No dinosaur, unicorn, other characters, rainbow, text, border or watermark. Keep the open sky clear.
scale: Princess spans 60% of the page width; Odette is small enough to fit comfortably on her broad back. Original transparent flying character artwork is reused directly. Native canvas exports the animation resting frame for static fallback.
